title: 源端按异常类型分类网络失败时，规格的错误码表写出 BusinessError.code 判据

triggers.read: 源端 catch 链按 IllegalArgumentException / SocketTimeoutException / UnknownHostException / IOException（含证书消息）分支，详情用 e.getMessage()
triggers.wrong: 规格的错误码表只以 Java 异常类名和 Java 消息字面量（如 'Trust anchor for certification path not found'）为判据；实现映射表里没有「Java 异常类型 → BusinessError.code」一行

scope: 规格里写网络失败分类的错误码表和实现映射表，目标端请求走 @ohos.net.http 时

how.text: 错误码表除源端异常类外写目标判据：@ohos.net.http 失败是 BusinessError，按 code 映射——2300003 URL 格式错误、2300006 无法解析主机、2300028 超时、2300060 / 2300077 证书校验
实现映射表加一行「Java 异常类型 → BusinessError.code」，依据写 SDK 声明的 @throws 条款；源端英文消息字面量只列作兜底

values.value: 2300003 - Invalid URL format or missing URL.
values.meaning: URL 格式错误，对源端 IllegalArgumentException
values.source: 鸿蒙 SDK 的 ets/api/@ohos.net.http.d.ts，HttpRequest.request 的 @throws

values.value: 2300006 - Failed to resolve the host name.
values.meaning: 无法解析主机，对源端 UnknownHostException
values.source: 鸿蒙 SDK 的 ets/api/@ohos.net.http.d.ts，HttpRequest.request 的 @throws
鸿蒙 SDK 的 ets/api/@ohos.net.http.d.ts，HttpRequest.request 的 @throws

values.value: 2300060 - Invalid SSL peer certificate or SSH remote key.；2300077 - The SSL CA certificate does not exist or is inaccessible.
values.meaning: 证书校验失败，对源端带 Trust anchor… 消息的 IOException
values.source: 鸿蒙 SDK 的 ets/api/@ohos.net.http.d.ts，HttpRequest.request 的 @throws

values.value: 2300003 → MALFORMED_URL，2300006 → UNKNOWN_HOST，2300028 → CONNECTION_ERROR，2300060 / 2300077 → CERTIFICATE；消息匹配降为兜底
values.meaning: 修复后分类正确、超时复测得到 'Operation timeout' 的映射

why: 错误码表只写 Java 判据时，实现者照着匹配英文消息，鸿蒙的失败全部落进 IO 错误

read: Trust anchor for certification path not found

alternatives_unverified: 2300007 - Failed to connect to the server. 也可对应连不上（断网/不可达端口），卡里没用
siblings_checked: 搜 @throws { BusinessError } 2300028：@ohos.net.http.d.ts 里 HttpRequest.request 三个重载、requestInStream 三个重载都带同一组码

refs.quote: @throws { BusinessError } 2300003 - Invalid URL format or missing URL.
@throws { BusinessError } 2300006 - Failed to resolve the host name.
@throws { BusinessError } 2300060 - Invalid SSL peer certificate or SSH remote key.
@throws { BusinessError } 2300077 - The SSL CA certificate does not exist or is inaccessible.
